audit_event_finished_at_check.name: audit_event_finished_at_check
audit_event_finished_at_check.value: (("audit_event"."status" in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') and "audit_event"."finished_at" is null) or ("audit_event"."status" in ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'TIMEOUT', 'CANCELLED', 'UNKNOWN') and "audit_event"."finished_at" is not null))

operation_finished_at_check.name: operation_finished_at_check
operation_finished_at_check.value: ("operation"."status" in ('pending', 'running', 'retryable') and "operation"."finished_at" is null) or ("operation"."status" in ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired') and "operation"."finished_at" is not null)

subscription_period_check.name: subscription_period_check
subscription_period_check.value: ("subscription"."current_period_start" is null and "subscription"."current_period_end" is null) or ("subscription"."current_period_start" is not null and "subscription"."current_period_end" is not null and "subscription"."current_period_end" > "subscription"."current_period_start")

template_snapshot_metadata_check.name: template_snapshot_metadata_check
template_snapshot_metadata_check.value: ("template"."artifact_type" = 'legacy-theme-reference') OR ("template"."snapshot_schema_version" is not null and "template"."source_pboot_version" is not null and "template"."source_core_commit" is not null and "template"."db_engine" is not null and "template"."db_schema_version" is not null)
